title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Protection skill warns of suspected social engineering
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap target from Microsoft's tenant-facing rollout schedule. The documented Facilitator controls and licensing are supported, and the remaining Protection-specific questions are appropriately left open.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Facilitator's Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for social engineering.
claims.quote: When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The skill is intended to identify suspected attempts by outsiders to trick participants into sharing sensitive information.
claims.quote: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users see a warning in the meeting if a suspected attempt is detected.
claims.quote: If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The warning offers users an option to end the meeting rather than stating that the skill ends it automatically.
claims.quote: Users will have options to end the meeting or temporarily restrict information sharing.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The warning offers users an option to temporarily restrict information sharing.
claims.quote: Users will have options to end the meeting or temporarily restrict information sharing.

claims.claim: Protection is invoked automatically when Facilitator is present in a meeting with participants outside the organisation.
claims.quote: When Facilitator is present in a meeting with participants outside your organization, the Protection skill is invoked automatically.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Limitation to confirm; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn currently lists Facilitator as unsupported in external chats and meetings, which the briefing reports alongside the notice.
claims.quote: Currently, Facilitator isn't supported in 1:1 chats, group chats, or external chats and meetings.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Facilitator app can be allowed or blocked in Teams admin center through Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls
claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell documents Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app-id> -AppAssignmentType Everyone for setting an app's availability to Everyone.
claims.quote:
Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone
Updates the availability value for Bookings app (App ID 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b) to Everyone.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft documents Update-M365TeamsApp for app-state management.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows administrators to modify app state, availability and installation status by adding or removing users and groups or changing assignment type or installation status.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The reference describes an example using -IsBlocked $true as unblocking an app.
claims.quote:
Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -IsBlocked $true
Unblocks Bookings app (App ID 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b).

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The reference also describes its example using -IsBlocked $false as unblocking an app.
claims.quote: Unblocks 1Page App (App ID 2b876f4d-2e6b-4ee7-9b09-8893808c1380) and updates installation setting for the app to include 3 users and 1 group.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators control Facilitator app availability for the whole organisation or selected users.
claims.quote: As an admin, you control whether Facilitator is available to your entire organization or to a certain group of users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified where the Protection skill's transcript analysis runs.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether Protection warnings are retained.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Facilitator Protection skill transcript analysis location warnings retention audit restrict information sharing. Opened purview/ai-teams-facilitator and facilitator-teams; general interaction retention is documented, but Protection warnings are not identified.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described what Protection's temporarily restrict information sharing option changes.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "restrict". Opened facilitator-teams and purview/ai-teams-facilitator; read MC1536056 and the roadmap. The notice and record name the option without explaining its mechanics.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap and notice name no Protection-specific setting, and no such setting is documented in the material found.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection" "block" "policy"; "Facilitator" "Protection" "PowerShell" settings license. Opened facilitator-teams and update-m365teamsapp; read roadmap and MC1536056. Found app availability and notes controls, no Protection-specific setting.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The documented effect of blocking the Facilitator app on Protection itself is not explicitly stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection" "block" "policy". Opened facilitator-teams and update-m365teamsapp; read MC1536056. App availability is documented and Protection requires Facilitator present, but Protection's behaviour after an app block is not described.
